A quick weeknight dinner idea is one‑pan lemon‑garlic chicken with roasted vegetables: season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, minced garlic, and lemon zest; toss chopped potatoes, carrots, and broccoli with olive oil, salt, and pepper; arrange everything on a baking sheet and roast at 425 °F for 35‑40 minutes, stirring halfway through. Serve with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
